validated_hosts.linux_windows: compile-only; no runtime or ABI conformance claim

capabilities.external_static_scene_workflow: validated external Khronos Box GLB; indexed hierarchy, source materials, three protected variants, inspect passes, select, persist and retry
capabilities.native_jobs: durable pinned CPU inputs, idempotent submissions, cancellation, bounded events, reconnect, output-budget failure; max 256 retained jobs
capabilities.browser: shared Rust semantic API, async WebGPU preview/cancellation, document-digest CAS under Web Locks, OPFS quota/abort/unclosed-write recovery, explicit export
capabilities.narrow_abi: Python ctypes full variant workflow and independent compiled C11 table/lifecycle/ownership checks; trusted synchronous memory-only ABI
capabilities.source_materials: explicit opt-in Lambertian conversion; metallic 0, roughness 1, opaque untextured materials; geometric normals; two-sided
capabilities.document: selected rendering intent authored transactionally in version 1; v0 remains readable; geometry and camera protected during variant edits

exclusions: input cameras, textures, full PBR and glTF extensions
animation, rigs, morphs, hair, volumes and blend files
durable browser job execution or remote rendering service
general visual editor, automatic merges, plugin execution or tenant isolation

resources.note: Debug native workflow process; measured host only. Output admission charges are not total RSS or VRAM measurements.

dependencies: No new runtime dependencies; unmodified Cesium CC-BY-4.0 fixture attribution in fixtures/khronos-box. Dependency inventory includes transitive features and platform exceptions.
